label: Derive an actual root from local finiteness and distinct-receipt coverage (inference)
rule: Apply the finite matching obstruction to the actual roster and eliminate a concrete ground
meaning: The unmatched sender is actual and concrete. If it had any actual concrete ground in the profile, it would admit an injective match, contradicting the obstruction. The root is relative to the profile's grounding relation. A freely chosen transfer class has no independent evidential force.
